claims.text: The Sol Foundation publishes a numbered white paper and policy briefing series including Gallaudet (March 2024), McCaw (May 2024), Skafish (November 2024), Karl Nell (May 2025), Villarroel-derived Briefing No. 1 (January 2026), McConnell Briefing No. 2 (April 2026) and von Rennenkampff Briefing No. 3 (April 2026).

edges.note: The Sol Foundation identifies von Rennenkampff as a Sol Foundation Fellow and carries his paper 'The Civilizational Risks of a UAP Technology Arms Race: Nonhuman Technology and Global Security', which argues for international cooperation on UAP technology development. Garry Nolan is listed as Executive Director of the Board. Tier 2: the foundation's public pages read here do not carry the Science and Policy Briefings series, so his role in it is not asserted from this source.
